title: Senior Product Analyst (w/m/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Wir suchen eine:n Senior Product Analyst, der/die analytische Präzision mit einem ausgeprägten Produktgespür verbindet. Du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren. Du bist Teil eines Product-Teams, das sich auf einen Teil der User Journey fokussiert, und arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die für diesen Bereich verantwortlich ist, sowie mit den Entwickler:innen, die daran bauen. Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird. Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich. Das wirst du konkret tun: Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung. Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten. KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann. Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen. Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann. Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen. Dein Profil Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt. Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren. Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards. Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen. Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt. Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum. Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools. Diese Rolle gibt dir mehr Einfluss und Kontrolle – aber dafür musst du unseren AI-Enablement-Stack nutzen und weiterentwickeln können. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich – du wirst Texte und Flows für deutschsprachige Nutzer:innen gestalten und bewerten. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Team. Bitte schick uns ein Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum diese Rolle und warum jetzt – und beschreibe mindestens ein Projekt, das du von Anfang bis Ende erläuterst: die Hypothese, was du getestet hast, das Ergebnis und was du daraus mitgenommen hast. Zeig uns, wie du Daten genutzt hast, um dein Denken voranzubringen, und wo Experimente das beeinflusst haben, was du gebaut hast. Was wir bieten Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das mindestens zwei Bürotage mit Remote-Arbeit kombiniert. Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir schaffen ein großartiges Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert für die Gemeinschaft Mitarbeit in einem fröhlichen und erfahrenen Team, das sich austauscht und voneinander lernt Einblick in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der Stiftung Verantwortung und große Möglichkeiten, dich aktiv einzubringen Deine SpenditCard – pro Monat erhältst du ein zusätzliches Einkommen von 35 Euro, das du für Dinge deiner Wahl einsetzen kannst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr – außerdem bieten wir die Möglichkeit von Workation-Modellen sowie eines Sabbaticals Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.<br><br><strong>Kimchi Inference</strong></p> <p>One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br>&nbsp;fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br>&nbsp;network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br>&nbsp;unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br>&nbsp;taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br>&nbsp;on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br>&nbsp;experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.&nbsp;</li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI&nbsp;</em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.<br><br><strong>The Auto Router</strong></p> <p>Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.</p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made </span></em><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.</p> <p>This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. Platform engineers own the proxy, the streaming path, and the fleet. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> routing is a prediction problem wearing a product's clothes. For every request you predict the quality each candidate model would deliver, what it would cost, and how fast it would decode, and you have to be right enough, in aggregate, that the savings are real and the quality never dips below frontier. The data is messy: rollout outcomes from benchmark harnesses, per-request records from the live fleet, override signals, and token streams whose speed depends on the serving concurrency at the moment. Speed itself is a correctness variable: on deadline-bound agentic work, a model that decodes three times slower doesn't do the same work slower, it does less work. That's why naive cost-per-token objectives quietly optimize for the wrong thing. And the bar for evidence is high: a router change ships only after production-parity evaluation with error bars, then gets held to its numbers in live traffic.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; PyTorch; SQL at scale (ClickHouse); OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM APIs; benchmark and rollout harnesses (RouterBench-class); GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've spent 5+ years in applied ML or ML research, and you've trained, evaluated, and shipped models that make real-time decisions (ranking, recommendation, bandits, pricing, or LLM routing) and you can tell that story with receipts.</li> <li>Strong Python and SQL at scale: you can pull, clean, and interrogate millions of request-level records without waiting on anyone.</li> <li>You know the difference between a model that got better and an eval that got easier.</li> <li>You have real opinions about what LLM benchmarks measure, agentic harnesses included.</li> <li>You know enough serving reality (TTFT, decode speed, batching, prefix caching, concurrency) to model the objective honestly.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, error bars and all.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Own the routing model end to end: features, objective, training, calibration, and release cadence. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

  • Propose a data collection strategy — research suitable public and clinical data sources, recommend patient consent and other administrative requirements for ML training (e.g., data protection agreements, ethics approval), and define collection and annotation protocols with clinical experts, including labeling guidelines and quality checks

  • Identify and validate factors that affect model performance — image conditions, dataset bias, patient diversity, data privacy and regulatory requirements

  • Define test strategies and metrics, and validate model outputs against clinician assessments

  • Perform build vs. buy analyses for models, tools and services, including cost comparison

  • Estimate compute and training costs and propose budgets for model training and deployment

  • Choose and set up training environments flexibly — local hardware or cloud — based on cost, data privacy and performance

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for the current prototyping stage and document results clearly

  • Maintain clear, traceable documentation of data sources, models, experiments and design decisions to support audits and quality reviews

  • Evaluate and integrate additional sensors where feasible (e.g., depth, LiDAR, thermal, multispectral) and fuse them with RGB input

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field — or equivalent practical background

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on use of PyTorch, OpenCV or TensorFlow

  • Working knowledge of the full ML lifecycle — data preparation, training, evaluation and deployment

  • Basic knowledge of generative models (diffusion models or GANs) and common open-source libraries

  • Comfortable training models both locally (GPU workstation) and on cloud platforms

  • Able to estimate ML compute costs and compare build vs. buy options to support budget decisions

  • Awareness of medical imaging challenges — limited data, label variability between clinicians and class imbalance

  • Awareness of healthcare data privacy and ethics (e.g., GDPR, patient consent, anonymization) and why explainability and bias matter in clinical AI

  • Able to read research papers and apply them pragmatically

  • Self-directed and pragmatic — able to take initiative and own problems end-to-end in a lean team

  • Fluent in English — German is a bonus

Strong Plus

  • Projects or coursework in medical imaging or clinical AI

  • Familiarity with semi-supervised learning — leveraging limited or partially labeled data

  • Experience with 3D data processing — depth maps, point clouds or mesh reconstruction

  • Exposure to multi-modal learning — combining RGB and depth or LiDAR data

  • Edge AI or wearable deployment (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, model quantization)

  • Knowledge of explainability methods (e.g., Grad-CAM, SHAP) or adversarial robustness

  • Awareness of medical device regulation for AI software (e.g., EU MDR, IEC 62304)

  • Durchführung von IT-Projekten und Erstellung von Standards und Prozessen im Support

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes IT-Studium, IT-Ausbildung (Fachinformatiker Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im IT-Betrieb inkl. Microsoft 365 im Unternehmensumfeld und Microsoft Azure
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an KI-Technologien, APIs, Datenverarbeitung und KI-gestützten Tools
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Windows-Client-Betriebssystemen, insbesondere Installation, Fehleranalyse, Richtlinien, Benutzerprofile, Treiber und Updates
  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder Projektleitung im IT-Umfeld
  • Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, das infrastrukturelle Zukunftsprojekt in
    Süddeutschland maßgeblich mitzugestalten. Wir werden das größte
    kommunale Breitbandnetz in Europa verantworten!
  • Die Aufgabe verspricht ein breit gefächertes Gebiet mit hoher Eigenverantwortung.
  • Unser Tarifvertrag bietet Sicherheit: Wir bieten Dir eine attraktive
    Vergütung sowie viele Zusatzleistungen wie eine tarifliche
    Jahressonderzahlung, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und ein jährliches Leistungsentgelt.
  • Deine Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig! Daher gibt es bei uns flexible
    Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Tage Jahresurlaub. Bei uns kannst Du außerdem
    Dein "Home" zum "Office" machen, um noch flexibler zu werden - drei Tage vor Ort, zwei Zuhause
  • Für deine Arbeit stellen wir dir hochwertiges technisches Equipment zur Verfügung.

Wenn Du ein Organisationstalent mit technischem Know-how bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! 🤩

Bist du bereit, bei Assemblean durchzustarten? Bei uns erwartet dich ein spannendes Umfeld! Ein Team in der deine Ideen wirklich Gehör finden und du aktiv zur Gestaltung unserer innovativen Projekte beitragen kannst. Unser Team begeistert sich für neueste Technologien und kreative Lösungen, und wir suchen jemanden, der genauso leidenschaftlich und neugierig ist wie wir. Als Ingenieur bei assemblean hast du die Möglichkeit, an wegweisenden Projekten zu arbeiten und deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln. Wenn du Lust auf eine neue Herausforderung hast und in einem motivierten Team arbeiten möchtest, dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Mach den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere und werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte!

Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von technischen Analysen und Problemlösungen für bestehende Systeme.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Ingenieuren und Teams, um innovative Technologielösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Supply-Chain-Koordination
  • Kunden- und Lieferantenakquise
  • Unterstützung und Durchführung von Entwicklungstätigkeiten je nach Bewerberprofil (z.B. CAD, CAE)

Qualifikation

  • Ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung (z.B. Techniker)
  • Erste Erfahrungen in einem der Felder Software- (am besten Python / Django oder SPS), Elektronik- (Platinen- oder Schaltplandesign) und / oder Produktentwicklung (CAD)
  • Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft zur Zusammenarbeit in unserem Team
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte einfach zu erklären
  • Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, selbstständig an Projekten zu arbeiten

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Produktion. Bewirb dich jetzt!

We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://wpp.com/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$" data-outlook-id="6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd">WPP.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Was macht ein Senior Post Producer (m/w/d) bei WPP Production?</strong></p> <p>Als Senior Post Producer (m/w/d) steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich den gesamten Post-Produktionsprozess von Werbefilmen – von der Budgetierung und Ressourcenplanung für Schnitt, VFX, Grading und Audio-Finishing bis hin zur Einhaltung strenger Zeitpläne. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, Agentur und Produktion führst Du souverän durch alle Abnahmeschleifen und stellt die fristgerechte sowie technisch einwandfreie Auslieferung der finalen Master sicher.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></p> <ul> <li>Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung, Führung und Nachkalkulation komplexer Budgets; Erfahrung in der Nachverhandlung von Change Requests und Scope-Erweiterungen</li> <li>Steuerung paralleler Projekte, Booking und Führung von Schnittplätzen, Grading-Suites, Tonstudios sowie In-House- &amp; Freelance-Artisten unter hohem Zeitdruck</li> <li>Souveräne Führung von Abnahme-Sessions (Offline/Online-Abnahmen, Sound-Laydowns) mit Regie, Kreativdirektion, Agenturen und Endkunden</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mehrjährige, einschlägige Erfahrung in der Post-Produktion von Werbefilmen (in einer Post-Production-Agency, Werbefilmproduktion oder Werbeagentur)</li> <li>Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Medienproduktion/Film, kaufmännische Ausbildung im Medienbereich oder vergleichbare fundierte Branchenerfahrung</li> <li>Exzellentes Verständnis der gesamten Post-Kette: Schnitt (Offline/Online), VFX/CGI, Color Grading, Motion Design, Mastering und Audio/Sounddesign</li> <li>Sicherer Umgang mit Post-Management-Tools (z. B. Frame.io) sowie solides Verständnis von NLEs und Suite-Standards (Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve)</li> <li>Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Master-Deliverables, Social-Media-Formatierungen (9:16, 4:5, 1:1), TV-Spezifikationen</li> <li>Hohe Belastbarkeit und Gelassenheit in engen Timelines, schnelle Lösungsfindung bei unvorhergesehenen Revisionsschleifen oder technischen Engpässen</li> <li>Feingefühl im Erwartungsmanagement zwischen kreativen Ansprüchen der Regie/Agentur und kommerziellen/zeitlichen Rahmenbedingungen</li> <li>Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (inkl. branchenspezifischer Fachbegriffe)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das bieten wir&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Bei uns findest du nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, das deine Entwicklung, Flexibilität und dein Wohlbefinden in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Entdecke unsere vielfältigen Vorteile:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li>Arbeitskultur &amp; Perspektiven:</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Spannende, vielseitige Projekte in einem schnell wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen</li> <li>Offene Vertrauenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung</li> <li>Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche zur Talentförderung und Karriereentwicklung.</li> <li>Umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über unser globales WPP Netzwerk (Trainings, Webinare, E-Learning)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li>Flexibilität &amp; Work-Life-Balance:</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Hybrid Working und flexible Arbeitszeiten</li> <li>Cross-Border Working (europaweit) – Arbeite flexibel auch jenseits der Landesgrenzen</li> <li>Ein zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten beineiner eingetragenen Wohltätigkeitsorganisation</li> <li>Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für eine produktive Umgebung</li> <li>28 reguläre Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einem zusätzlichen freien Tag an deinem Geburtstag</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li>Gesundheit &amp; Extras:</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellness-Angebote (z.B. psychologische Beratung, Fitness, Prävention)</li> <li>Attraktives Corporate-Benefit-Programm mit Rabatten bei zahlreichen Marken</li> <li>Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge (inkl. vermögenswirksamer Leistungen / VWL)</li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen</li> <li>Beteiligung am Deutschland Ticket</li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Du würdest deine Fähigkeiten gerne in einer internationalen Agentur weiter ausbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und schnellstmöglichen Verfügbarkeit.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Why work here:&nbsp;<br></strong><span data-teams="true">At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

About the Role

Following our acquisition of the spend management platform Yokoy, Perk is building a seamless, all-in-one solution for business travel and expenses. We are seeking an experienced, German-speaking Enterprise Account Manager to act as a strategic partner to our highest-value clients across the DACH region.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving client adoption, revenue retention, and expansion across our combined product suite. You will combine deep client empathy with data-driven consulting to establish yourself as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Lead and nurture a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building long-term relationships with key decision-makers and executive sponsors.

  • Portfolio Expansion: Systematically identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities, particularly around our expanded Yokoy spend management capabilities, to drive net revenue retention.

  • Executive Reviews: Deliver data-driven Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) to executive stakeholders, translating travel and spend analytics into clear ROI and actionable recommendations.

  • Product & Spend Expertise: Consult on platform best practices using complete mastery of the Perk and Yokoy product ecosystems.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of the customer, collaborating with Product, Support, and Onboarding teams to guide rollouts and influence product roadmaps.

  • Proactive Issue Resolution: Address complex operational or technical challenges early, establishing scalable solutions to ensure long-term retention.

What We're Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track Record: Proven success in Enterprise Account Management or Customer Success (SaaS, FinTech, or TravelTech preferred), with a history of consistently exceeding expansion and retention targets.

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to present to, negotiate with, and advise C-level executives.

  • Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate complex spend data into high-level business strategies that align client objectives with product capabilities.

  • Feedback-Driven & Collaborative: A low-ego, team-first approach that thrives on early feedback, rapid iteration, and cross-functional alignment.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Handle large measurement datasets spanning electrical, optical, and electro-optical characterization

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

title: Sr. Account Executive Enterprise Sales
description: <h2>The Team + The Role</h2> <p>Pendo’s Enterprise Sales team drives growth across the company’s largest and most strategic accounts. The team partners with senior business and technology leaders to position Pendo as a critical platform for product experience, data, analytics, and digital transformation. In DACH, this team plays a key role in expanding Pendo’s presence with major enterprise customers and prospects.</p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you will own new business across Pendo’s largest DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close, with a focus on $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities. This role requires a strategic enterprise seller who can build executive relationships, create disciplined account plans, and position Pendo’s AI-powered Data &amp; Analytics solutions with clarity and urgency.</p> <p>This role is based in our Munich office.</p> <h2>What this looks like day-to-day</h2> <ul> <li><strong>New logo acquisition:</strong> Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment. You will identify, engage, and convert high-value opportunities across large DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise sales execution:</strong> Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close. You will navigate matrixed organizations, align executive buyers, and keep deals moving with clear next steps and strong commercial discipline.</li> <li><strong>Strategic deal leadership:</strong> Consistently drive $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities by building value-based business cases. You will position Pendo’s AI-powered Data &amp; Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation for enterprise customers.</li> <li><strong>Executive relationship building:</strong> Build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and senior decision-makers. You will engage stakeholders with credibility, understand their priorities, and connect Pendo’s capabilities to strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Account planning:</strong> Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans for target enterprise accounts. You will map stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, and create focused plans that support new business acquisition and long-term account potential.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Collaborate across Pendo to win and expand strategic accounts. You will partner with internal teams to bring the right expertise into each opportunity and create a strong, coordinated customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline and forecast discipline:</strong> Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management. You will keep opportunity data current, communicate deal progress clearly, and manage your business with structure and accountability.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <p>Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.</p> <p>You're a builder, not a maintainer.</p> <p>You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Account Executives don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.</p> <p>You're AI-curious - genuinely.</p> <p>You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.</p> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong track record of closing $500K–$1M+ enterprise SaaS deals across DACH.</li> <li>Experience selling into large, complex, matrixed organizations with multiple senior stakeholders and executive buyers.</li> <li>Proven success in a start-up or high-growth environment, with the ability to operate with structure, urgency, and ownership.</li> <li>Background selling Data, Analytics, AI, or enterprise technology solutions.</li> <li>Passion for AI and technology, with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing the way people work.</li> <li>Confident engagement style with C-level leaders, senior decision-makers, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Structured, strategic, and highly self-driven approach to account planning, pipeline management, and deal execution.</li> <li>Fluent German and professional English.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience selling into DAX 40 prospect accounts or similarly large strategic enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Experience positioning AI-powered Data &amp; Analytics solutions as part of broader digital transformation initiatives.</li> </ul> <h2>About Pendo</h2> <p>Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.</p> <p><strong>Pendo Core Values:</strong> Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong> Robust, employer-backed social coverage paired with additional cash stipends, equity, and meaningful retirement and commute support.</p> <p><strong>EEOC:</strong> We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.</p> <p><strong>Accessibility:</strong> Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: ----- All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Account Executive (f/m/d)
description: Wir suchen einen motivierten Account Executive für unser wachsendes Account Executive-Team. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, den Sales Cycle in einem dynamischen, stark wachsenden ConTech-Unternehmen eigenverantwortlich zu übernehmen. Du wirst maßgeblich dazu beitragen, unsere Marktreichweite mit einem KI-gestützten Produkt auszubauen, das bereits einen bedeutenden Umsatztreiber darstellt. Tätigkeiten Verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, inklusive Zuarbeit von SDR's für SMB-Kunden – von der Akquise bis zum Abschluss. Steuerst Multi-Stakeholder-Beziehungen und stehst im Austausch mit Ansprechpartnern von Geschäftsführern bis hin zu CFOs und Einkaufsleitern. Setzt ausgeprägte Deal-Orchestrierungs-Fähigkeiten ein, um komplexe Buying Center zu navigieren. Gibst strukturiertes Marktfeedback an die Produktteams weiter. Arbeitest direkt mit dem VP Sales und CEO an der Deal-Strategie zusammen. Team Du wirst Teil eines Teams von 5 Account Executives und damit der 6. SMB-AE. Wir arbeiten mit einem Verhältnis von 2 SDRs pro AE. Zu Beginn sind AEs für die ersten Monate für den Aufbau ihrer eigenen Pipeline selbst verantwortlich, um ein tiefes Marktverständnis zu entwickeln, bevor sie – leistungsabhängig – SDR-Unterstützung erhalten. Du hast eine direkte Verbindung zum VP Sales und CEO für die Deal-Strategie. Berufserfahrung Für Midlevel-Positionen: 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Closing mit High-Velocity-Deals und mehreren Stakeholdern. Für Senior-Positionen: 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Closing mit High-Velocity-Deals. Nachweisliche Erfolge bei Deals mit einem ACV von 12.000 € oder mehr. Ausgeprägte Outbound-Erfahrung, einschließlich Prospecting, Pipeline-Aufbau und Kaltakquise. Fähigkeit, C-Level-Entscheider (Geschäftsführer, CFOs, Einkauf) zu überzeugen und zu beeinflussen. Sicherer Umgang mit einer strukturierten, beratungsorientierten Vertriebsmethodik. Hohe Eigenmotivation, Resilienz und die Fähigkeit, in einem wettbewerbsintensiven Umfeld zu bestehen. Teamplayer mit einer kollaborativen Denkweise. Cosuno – Wir revolutionieren die Baubranche durch Technologie. Wir sind Cosuno – ein schnell wachsendes Tech-Startup, das die Baubranche mit unserer digitalen Plattform für Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeprozesse effizienter und transparenter macht. Unser Ziel: Die komplexesten Herausforderungen der Branche mit Innovation und Einfachheit zu lösen. Warum Cosuno? Künstliche Intelligenz ist der Schlüssel zu unserer Lösung: Sie analysiert Millionen von Preisdatenpunkten und hilft Bauunternehmen dabei, präzise und effiziente Angebote zu erstellen. raw.title: Founding Account Executive – Benelux
raw.description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real.   • Design software within strict real-time constraints and low-latency requirements

Schnittstelle zwischen dem Bereich Operations und Customer Service, dem Legal-Team und unserem externen Datenschutzbeauftragten. Frühzeitige Identifikation von Risiken, Ableitung und Implementierung klarer, umsetzbarer Maßnahmen. Gezielter Ausbau von Datenschutz-Know-how im Team durch praxisnahe Schulung und Beratung. Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Technologiepartner sowie Abstimmung datenschutzrechtlicher Anforderungen mit Softwareentwicklungsteams . Erfahrung in der operativen Umsetzung von Datenschutzanforderungen in kunden- und datenintensiven Prozessen. Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen verständlich und praxisnah zu übersetzen. As Global Brand & Marketing Director you will lead Crytek’s global marketing function across brand, creative, performance, and lifecycle, reporting to the Chief Publishing Officer. You will own how Hunt: Showdown 1896 and unannounced projects are positioned, launched, and grown in market. 

You will lead the marketing team and build the creative engine and operating model that drive how Crytek’s games meet their players — campaigns with craft and conviction that earn attention, sustain communities, and translate brand ambition into commercial outcomes. You will partner with publishing leadership to keep marketing, communications, and product working as one connected system. 

This role demands creative judgement, marketing craft, and the rigor to drive brand ambition into measurable acquisition, retention, and revenue growth. 


Responsibilities

  • Define Crytek’s global marketing strategy across brand, creative, paid media, and CRM

  • Lead global positioning and creative direction for Hunt: Showdown 1896 and unannounced projects across all channels  

  • Own the marketing P&L, channel mix, and KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROAS, retention curves), and report performance to the CPO  

  • Lead a high-performing in-house creative engine: art direction, video, design, and campaign operations capable of supporting the portfolio and surge launches  

  • Concentrate creative, paid media, and CRM firepower during major launch windows  

  • Partner with publishing product leadership to translate product strategy into season plans, beats, and campaigns  

  • Champion AI fluency across research, analytics, and operational workflows, using it to amplify the work, so the teams' time goes to creative judgement and taste.  

  • Mentor and grow the marketing team, raising the bar on craft, speed, and accountability  


Requirements

  • 10+ years of marketing leadership across brand, performance, and CRM, with at least 5 in the video games industry  

  • Proven success leading global launches and live service marketing for multi-product portfolios  

  • Strong commercial fluency: CAC / LTV management, paid channel optimization, lifecycle and retention economics  

  • Experience building and leading multidisciplinary creative teams (art, video, design, copy)  

  • Track record using player insights, segmentation, and AI tooling to sharpen creative and media decisions  

  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to operate across matrixed, global organizations  

  • Passion for video games and a deep understanding of player communities  

  • Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt am Main, Germany  

What you can expect from us

Career Path 
Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
 
Relocation Support 
We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family. 
You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
 
Company Apartment 
To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
 
Public Transport Pass 
Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
 
Gym Card 
A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
 
State-of-the-art Office
We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
 
Hybrid Working
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
 
Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
 
German Classes 
Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family. 
  
Events
Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!

At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

raw.title: Interim Performance Marketing Manager - 3 month contract
raw.description:
About Bike Club

We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way.

Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer.

We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

The Role

We need a commercially driven performance marketer for three months to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany while we hire a permanent Performance Marketing Manager. You will manage our performance marketing agency and own delivery of our paid acquisition plan, using customer and commercial data to recommend where to invest, test and optimise. We are also open to a fractional role for the right candidate.

What You'll Do

  • Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners, challenging recommendations where needed.

  • Oversee day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition across the UK and Germany.

  • Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms.

  • Recommend how acquisition budget is allocated across markets, channels and campaigns.

  • Own reporting on CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value, working with Finance and Data.

  • Set up a simple test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative and landing pages.

  • Focus on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers, not just volume.

What success looks like at three months

  • Acquisition delivered to plan in the UK and Germany.

  • Clear acquisition KPIs and reporting in place.

  • Paid search restructure under way, with an accountable relationship with the agency.

  • A documented test roadmap and handover for the permanent hire.

About You

You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement.

  • Experience in performance marketing or growth within a consumer business or agency.

  • Experience managing agencies and a multi-channel market.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgement, able to turn data into clear actions.

  • Able to land quickly and work well with Marketing, Data, Finance and Commercial colleagues.

  • German market experience is a plus.

  • Available immediately!

Why BikeClub?

You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes.

spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports
