description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. ⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy. You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs. Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive. Why is our Vertical approach interesting? Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan. Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum. Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction. Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth. What will you do with us? You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing . The average sales cycle is 4-6 months , dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€ . At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects . We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless. We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company , challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base. Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew. ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you: Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role; Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English . Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills ; Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems; Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building; Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models; Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team; Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1; Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range . If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. #LI-DNP Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Social Media & Content Specialist
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ The role

Health is one of the most searched, shared and talked-about topics online. Millions of people scroll every day looking for answers about their sleep, their stress or their kids' fever. And yet, no brand owns that conversation. We want Alan to be the health voice people actually want to follow.

As Social Media & Content Specialist , you'll be the owner of Alan's organic social presence in France (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube…)

You'll join the Brand team and work side by side with an experienced content editorial team

What you’ll own

  • The France editorial line. Build and run the editorial calendar, content pillars (prevention, health tips, product, employer brand…) and posting cadence for each platform. Work with Brand, Product Marketing, Medical and Growth teams to pull the best stories, data and expertise from across Alan, and turn them into content.

  • Content creation. Create and ship social-first content yourself, every week: short videos (Reels, Shorts), carousels, statics and copy-led LinkedIn posts. You write the hooks, the scripts and the captions, you edit the videos and you design the visuals. You adapt each piece to its platform rather than posting the same thing everywhere.

  • Alan's voice on social. Define how Alan sounds on social: credible on health, but human, useful and sometimes funny. Spot the news, trends and formats worth jumping on, and react at the right moment, in the right tone.

  • Alan's big moments. Plan and run the social side of brand campaigns, product launches and events, from the idea to the publication, so that every major moment gets the reach it deserves.

  • Community. Reply to comments and messages, moderate, spark conversations, and collaborate with Alan experts (doctors, psychologists…), employees and creators to grow an engaged audience.

  • Performance. Follow the analytics, run regular test-and-learn on formats, hooks and timing, and share a simple monthly review with the team. Work with Growth and Data to track what social brings to Alan (traffic, awareness, audience quality).

  • AI in the creative and distribution process. Use AI tools to create more, faster and better, and help us shape how AI fits into our content production and distribution workflow, with the support of our engineers.

Who we’re looking for

  • You create. You still open the tools yourself (CapCut, Premiere, Figma, Canva, AI tools…) and love making content. You don't brief others to do it for you.

  • You live and breathe social. You get the trends, the memes and the codes of each platform, and you know when (and when not) to jump in.

  • You have taste and a pen. You write sharp, punchy copy and can tell a strong idea from a weak one.

  • You take ownership. You go and get the information you need, make decisions, ship at the right moment and follow through.

  • You're data-minded. You care about what a post changed, not just the likes, and use the numbers to decide what's next.

  • You're scrappy and curious. You make great content, and you're always testing new formats, platform features and tools.

  • You collaborate. You make it easy and fun for people across Alan to contribute to social, and you're energised by a blank page.

Requirements for the role

You may be a great fit if you’ve:

  • 2–5 years of hands-on social media experience (brand, media or agency side), with at least one account you owned or co-owned

  • A portfolio of content you created yourself, across formats (short video, carousels, copy)

  • Experience on at least two of Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn

  • French fluent level, with flawless written French: most of the content will be in French

  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Spanish or Dutch is a plus, given Alan's presence in Spain and Belgium

  • Based in France

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C1 level range.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Community Manager (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Communication à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Rattaché(e) à la Social Media Manager, vous l’accompagnerez dans la gestion quotidienne de nos réseaux sociaux. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la planification et de la gestion du contenu sur nos plateformes de médias sociaux pour renforcer notre image de marque et engager notre communauté en ligne. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Préparation, planification des contenus et gestion des prises de parole quotidiennes (timeline & stories) ; Copywriting des captions sur Instagram ; Proposition et déploiement des actions d’animation de la communauté ; Veille des tendances digitales et sociales ainsi que des contenus UGC; Analyse des performances. Requirements Profil Vous êtes étudiant(e), en école de communication, en école de commerce, ou équivalent universitaire et vous recherchez un stage. raw.description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Community Manager (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Communication à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à la Social Media Manager, vous l’accompagnerez dans la gestion quotidienne de nos réseaux sociaux. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la planification et de la gestion du contenu sur nos plateformes de médias sociaux pour renforcer notre image de marque et engager notre communauté en ligne.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • Préparation, planification des contenus et gestion des prises de parole quotidiennes (timeline & stories) ;
  • Copywriting des captions sur Instagram ;
  • Proposition et déploiement des actions d’animation de la communauté ;
  • Veille des tendances digitales et sociales ainsi que des contenus UGC;
  • Analyse des performances.

Requirements

Profil

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e), en école de communication, en école de commerce, ou équivalent universitaire et vous recherchez un stage. Idéalement, vous justifiez d’une première expérience dans un domaine proche ;
  • Vous avez le goût des belles images et des mots qui inspirent ;) ;
  • Vous avez un vrai intérêt pour les réseaux sociaux et vous les utilisez quotidiennement ;
  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre esprit de synthèse, rigueur et attention aux détails ;
  • Vous êtes curieux/se, proactif/ve et vous avez l’esprit d’équipe.

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

title: Accountant (m/f/d)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in France. As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team. Accountabilities: Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records. Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis. Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness. Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews. Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed. Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities. Prepare German VAT filings, including Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung and Zusammenfassende Meldung, and support payroll tax declarations (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung) in collaboration with external payroll providers and tax advisors. Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with German Commercial Code (HGB) requirements, as well as statutory audits and tax filings. Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and compliance practices. Review and improve existing accounting processes, resolve outstanding items, clean up historical ledger discrepancies, and establish more efficient financial workflows. Prepare financial KPIs and management reports, validating data accuracy and consistency before submission. Support monthly variance analysis by comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, investigating discrepancies, and providing relevant insights. Collaborate with the wider finance team on daily accounting operations, reporting activities, process improvements, and special projects. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for German accounting practices under HGB and German tax requirements. Experience in the software, technology, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry. Solid understanding of accrual accounting, financial reconciliations, journal entries, closing procedures, and financial reporting. Practical knowledge of German VAT requirements and familiarity with payroll tax declarations and statutory reporting obligations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and accounting reports. Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting and enterprise resource planning systems is an advantage. Experience managing multiple legal entities or multi-currency accounting is a plus. A professional qualification in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related discipline is desirable. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and reliability, with a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial documentation and reporting. A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to resolve historical accounting issues, organize incomplete records, and improve existing processes. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities in a fully remote environment. Strong teamwork and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate proactively with colleagues, external advisors, and service providers across remote teams. Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new systems, expand responsibilities, and develop professionally over time. Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken. Residence in Europe and legal authorization to work in the country of residence. Being based in or near Berlin is an advantage. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement: Work remotely from an eligible location within Europe. International working environment: Collaborate with finance professionals and stakeholders across an international software group. Entrepreneurial team culture: Benefit from a hands-on environment that encourages ownership, initiative, and practical problem-solving. Professional development: Expand your accounting expertise and gain exposure to international financial operations, reporting, and process improvement. Meaningful responsibilities: Take ownership of day-to-day accounting activities and contribute directly to the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations. Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.

• Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
• Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.
• Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and spearhead new initiatives.

• You'll be building for Europe's fastest-growing business banking market, with 600K+ clients across multiple countries and ambitious expansion plans
• Work in an environment that prioritizes quality, comprehensive code reviews, component approach and continuous refactoring as standard practice
• Contribute to a fully Swift-based app using MVP and Coordinators architecture, with modern CI/CD through GitHub, Firebase, and Bitrise
• Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
 
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
 
Your future team

As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.

Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.

We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.

title: Senior Creative Designer
description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! The role  We’re looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our Brand team in Paris. You’ll help build a brand that is understood, remembered and trusted, making a powerful product feel simple, human and desirable. As part of our creative team, you’ll shape Brevo’s visual identity, content and digital presence across every channel and market. We believe great design starts with great thinking, so we question the brief, look for the sharpest idea and make sure it holds across every touchpoint.   Your impact at Brevo Contribute to the evolution of Brevo's visual identity and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint, from paid ads to event signage. Design marketing and communication assets for product launches and campaigns, adapting concepts across channels, formats and markets (digital, social media, OOH, events, print). Produce social-first content, including video, motion and short-form, for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and X, tailored to each platform's codes. Build content plans that combine organic, paid and evergreen content, then measure performance and keep improving. Translate complex product features into simple, engaging messages for different audiences and markets. Partner with Growth, Product, Sales and Leadership to align creative work with business objectives. Experiment with new formats and AI-powered creative tools, and bring what works into the team's workflow. Who you are Around 6 years of experience in creative, brand or content design, ideally in an agency, startup or SaaS/tech company, with a strong portfolio of brand, content and digital work. You think before you design: you take the time to understand the product, challenge briefs constructively and turn complex ideas into clear visual stories. You have a solid understanding of B2B communication, paid campaigns, social media best practices and storytelling. You’re comfortable with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Claude…) You're fluent in Figma (mandatory, including design systems) Adobe suite. You're autonomous and organised, juggle several projects at once and take ownership from idea to execution. You communicate in professional English (C1 or above). Bonus points if you have B2C experience, speak French. If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply! Why people love working at Brevo A place to grow, together:  Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood. Practical perks for everyday balance:  RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day). Learning, every step of the way:  Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support. Flexible for life:  A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents. Wellbeing that works:  Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform A culture that cares:  From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work. Our candidate journey Introductory TA call (30 min) Meeting and Portfolio review with Rémi, Senior Brand & Com Director. (40 min) Creative case study (4–5 hours of work) and presentation (45 min) Final interview with our CMO (30 min) Reference check  Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you. raw.title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
raw.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')

  • Meeting with the teams

title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management (UK/EU)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland</span></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview of Role:</strong></p> <p>The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities</li> <li>Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance</li> <li>Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.</li> <li>Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.</li> <li>Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.</li> <li>Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.</li> <li>Supports the accountability of CSM team to oversee packaging, labelling, release, distribution, resupply, returns, reconciliation and destruction activities across global locations</li> <li>Develops and maintains supply project budgets, resource plans and integrated schedules, monitors performance and proactively resolves variances</li> <li>Manages CDMO and service-provider activities from RFP and contracting support through routine operations, troubleshooting, invoicing and performance management using defined KPIs and service expectations</li> <li>Supports IXRS selection, design, set-up, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation and ongoing operational performance as required by IRT Management Team.</li> <li>Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity</li> <li>Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working</li> <li>Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function</li> <li>Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc, MSc, engineering or pharmacy degree, or equivalent, with a minimum of 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) environment</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply</li> <li>Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes</li> <li>Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements</li> <li>Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools</li> <li>Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results</li> <li>Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management</li> <li>Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes</li> <li>Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations</li> <li>Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers</li> <li>Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership</li> <li>Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly</li> <li>Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements</li> <li>Technically title: Business Analytics & Insights Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>ABOUT SOTHEBY'S</strong></p> <p>Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>Working closely with the Head of Luxury Division and the Managing Director Switzerland, the role provides meaningful business insights, performance visibility and strategic reporting to support decision-making across the business. The position acts as an enabler to specialists and leadership teams by translating commercial and client data into actionable intelligence, helping identify trends, opportunities and areas of focus.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Client Analytics &amp; Growth Insights</p> <ul> <li>Leverage internal client data and CRM tools to provide visibility on client activity, engagement patterns and growth opportunities across categories.</li> <li>Support specialists and leadership teams by identifying client trends, areas of opportunity and potential cross-category connections.</li> <li>Contribute to client acquisition and development initiatives through data-driven analysis and actionable insights.</li> <li>Analyse client acquisition, retention and reactivation trends to support business planning and prioritization.</li> <li>Develop reporting and insights on key client-related KPIs.</li> <li>Collaborate with global client strategy teams to share best practices and ensure alignment of methodologies and reporting.</li> </ul> <p>Business Performance Analytics &amp; Reporting</p> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain reporting frameworks, dashboards and KPI tracking tools for the Luxury business.</li> <li>Provide visibility on performance across auctions, private sales and client development activities.</li> <li>Produce regular business reviews and performance reporting for the Luxury and Swiss leadership team.</li> <li>Monitor key performance indicators and highlight trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.</li> <li>Conduct pre-sale, during-sale and post-sale analyses to support business discussions and future planning.</li> <li>Develop auction intelligence reporting and market insights to support decision-making.</li> <li>Analyse bidding activity, buyer participation, conversion metrics and international selling patterns.</li> <li>Develop auction and sales performance reporting on the Luxury and Switzerland's contribution to the wider Sotheby's business.</li> <li>Translate complex business data into actionable insights and recommendations.</li> </ul> <p>Process Improvement, Automation &amp; Data Enablement</p> <ul> <li>Support strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing business visibility, reporting capabilities and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions.</li> <li>Partner with P&amp;T teams to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.</li> <li>Support the implementation and adoption of new tools, processes and reporting frameworks.</li> <li>Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring coordination, analysis and stakeholder engagement.</li> <li>Help reduce manual reporting activities and improve scalability through process optimisation.</li> </ul> <p>Leadership Reporting &amp; Communications</p> <ul> <li>Prepare executive-level presentations, business reviews and strategic updates for Luxury and Swiss leadership.</li> <li>Translate complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable business insights.</li> <li>Produce materials that support leadership discussions, planning and decision-making.</li> <li>Develop presentation materials for senior management meetings and business reviews.</li> <li>Facilitate communication across functions to ensure alignment on reporting, priorities and objectives.</li> <li>Ensure stakeholders have timely access to relevant performance, client and market insights.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>IDEAL EXPERIENCE &amp; raw.title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
raw.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
raw.description:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br>&nbsp;fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br>&nbsp;network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache.
